name: Periodic Table of Elements (elements + science)
description: 118 element cards (flip for details / cosmic origin) + 10 science story cards tracing how elements were forged from the Big Bang to the present.

sampleData.fun_fact: The most abundant element in the universe, making up about 75% of its mass.
Earth's core is mostly iron, and your blood uses iron in hemoglobin to carry oxygen.

sampleData.title: The beginning: the first few minutes
sampleData.body: Within about 3-20 minutes after the birth of the universe, temperatures dropped enough for protons and neutrons to combine, producing hydrogen (~75% of mass), helium (~25%), and trace amounts of lithium and beryllium. Heavier elements could not yet form - nuclei of mass 5 and 8 are too unstable, so fusion hit a 'dead end' here. Roughly 90% of the atoms in your body came from those first minutes.
